name: Mikoto
message: 「Yo, you’re here.」
As I headed toward the school gate, Sasaki-sensei was standing there, leaning against it.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Is Momiji not with you？」

name: Iori
message: 「She had some light errands to finish up, but she said she’d be here shortly.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Hmm, fair enough, then.」

name: Iori
message: 「So, Sasaki-sensei, did you need something from me？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Yeah... well, you know. It’s nothing all that important, really.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「I just wanted you to meet these guys.」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, o-ohhh...！ How adorable...！」
Emerging from the shadow of the school gate were two children.

name: Iori
message: 「Are they your children, Sasaki-sensei?」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Hey Muragaki, do I look like a mother to you？」
Apparently not.

name: Iori
message: 「Um, is it alright if I talk to them？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Well, I don't mind if you do.」
With permission granted, I immediately started talking to them.

name: Iori
message: 「Little ladies, can you tell me your names~？」

name: Miyako
message: 「I’m Miyako.」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「I, I’m Tsubaki...」

name: Iori
message: 「I see, I see! What are you two doing here today~？」
I crouched down to meet their eyes and sent a smile toward Miyako-chan and Tsubaki-chan.

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Who are you？」

name: Iori
message: 「I’m Muragaki Iori. I’m a teacher at this academy. If there’s anything you don’t understand, just ask me anything, okay！」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Okay, thank you!」
Aaaahhhhh... so cute, so precious, just too precious...！
My brain feels like it’s melting.

name: Mikoto
message: 「So that’s the face you make when you’re around kids...」

name: Iori
message: 「What do you mean, 'that kind of face'？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「The kind of face that’s just embarrassingly, mushily obsessed.」
S-so that’s how I looked to others…

name: Iori
message: 「No, but, that can’t be helped, right? I mean, kids are just so cute！」

name: Iori
message: 「Just look at those innocent eyes and that pure, guileless smile！」

name: Iori
message: 「Whenever I think about the future, brimming with potential for these children, I feel like I’m going to burst into tears.」

name: Iori
message: 「They say that they’re ‘so cute you could put them in your eyes and it wouldn’t hurt,’ and I really think that’s the absolute truth.」

name: Iori
message: 「I’d stake my life on it for the sake of these children！」

name: Mikoto
message: 「……So he’s just a straight-up lolicon.」

name: Iori
message: 「N-no, that’s not it！ I just purely, genuinely love children！」
I clench my fists and insist forcefully.

name: Miyako
message: 「……Maybe he’s a bit of a dangerous person？」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「I-I wonder, I think he’s a good person, though……」

name: Iori
message: 「Wait, wait！ I’m not a suspicious person！？」

name: Miyako
message: 「Everyone who’s suspicious always says they aren’t.」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「I guess he really is a bad guy……」

name: Iori
message: 「Oh, noooooo, they’re wary of me……！」
I clutch my head and writhe in agony.

name: Momiji
message: 「……Sensei, why are you writhing all by yourself？」
Just as I was sinking into the depths of despair, feeling like the world had come to an end, Momiji finally showed up.

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Ah, Big Sister Momiji！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Eh, Tsubaki……？ Why are you here！？」
'Big Sister,' so these girls are Momiji’s younger sisters then.

name: Tsubaki
message: 「I missed you, Big Sister Momiji.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Oh, there, there. Tsubaki, you’re so sweet and precious, aren’t you.」
Momiji catches Tsubaki as she throws herself into her arms and strokes her hair.

name: Tsubaki
message: 「That outfit of yours is super cool too, Big Sister Momiji！」

name: Momiji
message: 「This right here is Murakumo Academy's uniform~」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Even that cape-like thing？」
Tsubaki-chan points at the cloak Momiji is wearing and asks.

name: Momiji
message: 「Grandfather gave this to me as a gift. He said something or other about showing the dignity and prestige of the Suzakuin family.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, none of that matters to me, though~」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Hehehe, that cape is super cool too!」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「I wanna enroll at Murakumo Academy and wear clothes like that too~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Mm-hmm, you'll be able to！ Because you're such a good girl, Tsubaki~！」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Ehehe, then when I enroll, I'll ask Grandfather for a cape too!」
Ah... so precious. No other words are needed. Simply precious.

name: Miyako
message: 「...Momiji-oneechan」
On the other hand, Miyako-chan seems somewhat hesitant.

name: Momiji
message: 「I'm glad you came too, Miyako~. Come on, come over here!」

name: Miyako
message: 「Ehh, I'm good~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hehehe, you're such a shy one, Miyako~！」

name: Miyako
message: 「Th-That's not it at all!」

name: Momiji
message: 「Oh, don't be like that! Come on, let's hug, hug, hug!」
Along with Tsubaki-chan, Momiji pulls Miyako-chan into a tight hug too.

name: Miyako
message: 「H-Hey... stop it, it's embarrassing~」
Hahaha, Miyako-chan is at that precocious age, huh.

name: Mikoto
message: 「So, these two are Miyako, the third daughter of the Suzakuin family, and Tsubaki, the fourth daughter.」

name: Iori
message: 「Man, they really are adorable.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Quit looking at them like some old man doting on his grandkids. What I'm about to tell you isn't that kind of heartwarming story.」

name: Iori
message: 「What do you mean by that？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Well, there's a lot of backstory to it, so skipping all that and getting straight to the conclusion...」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Apparently, these two ran away from home.」

name: Iori
message: 「Wha... ran away from home？ Whaaaaaaaaat！？」
Kids this small, all by themselves...？

name: Momiji
message: 「Miyako, is that true？」

name: Miyako
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Why would you do such a thing...」

name: Miyako
message: 「Because Father got mad at me. Even though I didn't do anything wrong.」
It seems a fight with their father is the reason they ran away.

name: Iori
message: 「S-Sasaki-sensei！ What should we do！？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Hmm, I wonder what we should do.」

name: Momiji
message: 「What do you mean 'what'? Obviously, the only option is to send them back home.」

name: Miyako
message: 「No. I'm not going back.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hey, Miyako, if you don't go back, what are you planning to do from now on？」
Pushed by Momiji, little Miyako falls silent.

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Momiji-oneechan... don't be mad at Miyako-oneechan. Miyako-oneechan didn't do anything wrong.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Mm, I'm not really mad at her, though.」

name: Momiji
message: 「But, we can't just leave it at this and stay silent. We have to report this to Father.」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Ugh, *sniff*... Miyako-oneechan is going to get scolded~」

name: Momiji
message: 「Waaaaah, d-don't cry, Tsubaki!」

name: Momiji
message: 「I got it, I won't tell! I won't tell Father!」

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji sure is weak when it comes to her little sisters...」
Well, it can't be helped. They say you can't win against a crying child or a landlord.
Besides, they're cute, after all！

name: Mikoto
message: 「Muragaki, stop grinning and come with me for a second.」
Led away by Sasaki-sensei, I went to a spot a little further away.

name: Iori
message: 「What's going to happen to Miyako and Tsubaki from here on out?」

name: Iori
message: 「I think it'd be trouble if we didn't at least report this to their parents...」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Rest easy. I've already contacted Masatane myself.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「He'd been hiring dozens of people to look for them, so he sounded relieved they were finally found.」

name: Iori
message: 「Is that so? That's a relief...」

name: Mikoto
message: 「There's nothing relieving about it.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Apparently, Miyako and the others ran away from home over a week ago.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「And yet, they didn't even contact the police, trying to search for them on their own. Honestly, what are they thinking?」

name: Iori
message: 「Wait... over a week? Just the two of them！?」

name: Iori
message: 「Where on earth have Miyako and the others been, and what were they doing all this time？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「I'll be asking them that shortly, though I have a rough idea.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Ever since she was little, Miyako has had this habit of running away—or rather, not coming home.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Whenever I heard her stories, she'd say she was playing with Keyou or sleeping in trees. She's always been a wild child.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「This time was likely just an extension of that, wandering about here and there.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Though, after wandering for so many days, she probably ran out of pocket money.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「So, she ended up showing up at her sister Momiji's place.」

name: Iori
message: 「T-that's quite extraordinary... What about Tsubaki？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Tsubaki is stuck to Miyako like glue. She probably just tagged along because she didn't want to be alone.」
I see, so Tsubaki is a sister-dependent girl.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Fortunately, we were able to find them safe and sound. I'd like to have them sent home right away, but that's going to be difficult.」

name: Iori
message: 「Why is it difficult？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Tsubaki will likely go home if you explain things to her properly. She's obedient and very straightforward at heart.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「But that probably won't work with Miyako.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「She survived on her own for a week and still chose to come to Momiji's rather than go home.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Even though she's a child, she left home with quite a bit of resolve. She's not going to break easily.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Plus, Miyako is... well, she's naturally sharp. She's highly perceptive, and sweet-talking her won't work.」

name: Iori
message: 「Even so, don't we have no choice but to bring her back...？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Miyako is already a fine swordsman.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「If you want to keep her in one place while ignoring her own wishes, your only option is to take away her Origami and lock her in a cell.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Can you do that？」

name: Iori
message: 「O-of course I can’t！」

name: Iori
message: 「Just because she’s a child, that doesn’t mean I’m going to discard her feelings and lock her up. Heaven might forgive that, but I won’t！」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Well, that’s how it is.」
Man, either way, this means it’s not going to be straightforward...

name: Iori
message: 「Is it not possible to have her parents persuade her？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Her father, Masatane, is a stubborn and inflexible man. He’s the reason Miyako ran away from home in the first place.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Even if he came to persuade her now, it would likely just have the opposite effect.」
According to the story, Miyako had broken a family heirloom spiritual blade, and when he scolded her for it, she got angry and ran off.

name: Iori
message: 「Doesn't that suggest there was something wrong with the way he scolded her...?」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Nine times out of ten, that’s exactly it.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「But he isn’t the type to lower his head easily. Especially not to a child.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Well, Masatane married into the family and has struggled with being looked down upon. I can’t say I don’t understand his feelings, but...」
It seems Sasaki-sensei and the head of the Suzakuin family, Masatane, have a reasonably close relationship.

name: Mikoto
message: 「As for the other one, her mother Sayuki, she’s a carefree one.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Regarding this incident, she’s even saying something as laid-back as, ‘Oh my, it’s just a little trip. Have fun, dear.’」

name: Iori
message: 「No, no, no, no, aren’t you worried！？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Miyako might look young, but she’s quite a skilled hand. She could easily beat up a thug without even using an Origami.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Since she knows that, she probably figures things will work out even if she leaves her alone for a bit.」
Amazing, the Suzakuin family... If the child is like that, the parents are just as off-the-wall.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Well, that’s partly why Miyako came to Momiji, who is the most reliable one in the family.」

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji is the most reliable...？」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Yeah, that’s right. Pretty funny, isn’t it, that *Momiji* of all people is the most reliable one？」

name: Iori
message: 「M-Momiji's one of four sisters, right? What's the second daughter like?」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Nadeshiko, huh... She's a bright, good kid, though.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「She's a hot-blooded sporty girl with nothing but Jindou on the brain. Well, to put it simply, she's a Jindou nut.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「If I remember right, she should be training as a swordsmith with the <d0087>Sanjou Family</d> right now.」
The first head of the Suzakuin family was both a swordsman and an accomplished swordsmith.
Only you can forge a blade worthy of entrusting your life to. The finest blade for you is one born from within.
Even now, members of the Suzakuin family continue to uphold that founding head's philosophy, training under swordsmiths to forge blades of their own.

name: Mikoto
message: 「Well, regardless. We have to find some way to persuade Miyako.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「If we try to force her, she'll just run away and go missing again. That would defeat the whole purpose.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「So I'm thinking we send Tsubaki home and have Momiji look after Miyako for a while.」

name: Mikoto
message: 「The dorm rooms are spacious, so she can at least let Miyako stay there for a bit, right?」

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji is really going to hate that, though...」

name: Mikoto
message: 「Oh, please—she can't turn down a favor from us. Isn't that right？」

name: Iori
message: 「...You're pretty wicked too, Sasaki-sensei.」
We exchange a mischievous grin.

name: Mikoto
message: 「That's all for the explanation. You go tell Momiji. It'll go better that way.」

name: Iori
message: 「Understood.」

name: Iori
message: 「So that's the deal, Momiji—we're leaving Miyako-chan in your care.」

name: Iori
message: 「I need you to take Miyako-chan in at your dorm room.」
I report to Momiji what Sasaki-sensei and I just discussed.

name: Momiji
message: 「Wh-Whaaaaaaaaaaaaat？！」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hold on a second~！ Why me？！」

name: Iori
message: 「Miyako-chan and Tsubaki-chan came all this way counting on you. You can't just abandon them, right？」

name: Momiji
message: 「W-Well, maybe so, but...！」

name: Miyako
message: 「Big sis... you don't want to？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh... Th-That's not true~!」
Under Miyako-chan's intense gaze, Momiji forces a strained smile.

name: Iori
message: 「But Tsubaki-chan, you need to go home.」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Aww, nooo！ I don't wanna be the only one going home！」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Ugh, sniff... Why am I the only one being left out？」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「That's so mean, that's just so mean...！」
I gently pat Tsubaki-chan's head as big tears roll down her cheeks.

name: Iori
message: 「It's because you're still little, Tsubaki-chan.」

name: Iori
message: 「Besides, you're not the one who had a fight with your parents, right？」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Y-Yeah...」

name: Iori
message: 「Both your dad and your mom are worried sick because you suddenly disappeared.」

name: Iori
message: 「They might even be crying right now, wishing they could see you.」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Mother, Father...」

name: Iori
message: 「I'll make sure you get to see Momiji and Miyako-chan again soon.」

name: Iori
message: 「When that time comes, let's all play together—Sensei and your big sisters, all of us.」

name: Iori
message: 「I'll definitely come see you, Tsubaki-chan. I promise！」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「Really？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, of course！」

name: Iori
message: 「So, Tsubaki-chan, let's go home for today, okay？」

name: Tsubaki
message: 「...Okay, I got it. I'll go home.」
Whoa, she actually listened to me.
Tsubaki-chan is such an honest, good girl—she's seriously adorable...！！

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, that settles everything.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Wait, how does that settle anything？! My privacy is being violated here!」

name: Iori
message: 「Come on, it's fine—it's only for a little while.」

name: Iori
message: 「Besides, Miyako-chan, you'd rather be with your big sister than all alone, right？」

name: Miyako
message: 「...If Big Sis doesn't want me around, I'm fine on my own.」

name: Iori
message: 「Come on, come on~ Are you really okay with this, Momiji? Letting your little sister say something like that?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh, grrrr... Dammit~ Taking advantage of my weak spot like that~」

name: Miyako
message: 「So that's how you talk at the academy, Sis. Even though you were always so ladylike at home.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Huh？ Ah, n-no, this is, um...」

name: Iori
message: 「Pfft... Ahahahahahaha, is that right！」
So Momiji was in honor student mode at home, huh.

name: Momiji
message: 「Argh, stop laughing alreadyyyyy！」
